caption_L2L3: The general trend of gross output is upwards. There are some dips in the output in 2001 and 2009 but the chart is not specific enough in years so be certain that these are the years as the linear scale goes up in 5s. There is a major upward trend of output between 2009 and 2011 but there is no way of knowing why this is from the chart. Although the overall trend is upwards between 2015 and 2017 the output has reduced.
